# A09-S98: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

I CC’d you just on the links to the two sound broadcasts from DR and Ingeniøren. I'm a bit annoyed at Ingeniøren because I had said very clearly that I am an artist-researcher at MindFuture Foundation and talked about the eighteenth global goal and the hub, and then he introduces me by saying that I - as far as he can see on Google - am from Aarhus University. And that is just my education … sigh!

Well, otherwise it all sounds really good and has become some good presentations.

Looking forward to talking soon!
